name: Filter-out transition
lesson:
## Sweep the old track into the air

Bring B in normally, then take A's filter high-pass over 16 bars, thinning it until only hats and air remain, and pull A's fader once there is nothing left to lose. Reset the filter to centre after A is out so the next track loads clean.

A filter sweep is a bass swap and an energy build in one move, which is why it dominates melodic and progressive sets.
